policy: Use the least expensive model likely to produce accepted work; escalate only from demonstrated failure.

assignments.rationale: Shared action-admission seam, GitHub progression, integration, package and canonical records.
Bounded controller-owned REST mapping and deterministic recovery negatives.
Separate local deploy/smoke and configured CI observation without live mutation.

priorAssignments.rationale: Shared contracts, integration, package and CLI, canonical records, consequential verification, and manager coordination.
One bounded read-only pass settled recovery, identity, telemetry, provider-outcome, cancellation, and caller-authentication seams before writer fan-out.
Append-only recovery, exclusive ownership, atomic reservations, and SQLite reconstruction are concurrency and authority sensitive.
Workspace containment, environment filtering, process identity, Docker boundaries, and uncertain termination require deeper bounded implementation.
Explicit start and resume, event normalization, model compatibility, live scratch evidence, and truthful capability gaps are acceptance sensitive.
Caller authentication, revision-bound scope, revocation races, idempotency, and intent-before-effect require security-sensitive bounded implementation.
The boundary review proved interfaces and fakes were insufficient; the existing Terra writer was reused for argv-only native and Docker transports with exact identity and deadline hooks.
The durable-state writer was reused for the thin single-worker admission-to-provider-final path, avoiding another shared-contract writer.

One narrow read-only review crafted recovery, action-forgery, revocation, provider-outcome, and isolation failures; confirmed consequential gaps triggered targeted remediation without a second broad review.

history.summary: Foundation, tracking, provider feasibility, and frozen fixtures; fixture acceptance escalated from Luna medium to Terra high after observed evidence gaps.

Configuration, provisioning, context, lifecycle skills, TypeScript package conversion, and manager remediation; strict provisioning and CLI work escalated from Terra high to Sol high after repeated incomplete strictification.

materialChanges.reason: The phase brief required a narrowly scoped native dependency build and actual SQLite exercise; no unrelated dependency scripts were enabled.

from.implementation: adapter and execution interfaces with fake transports

to.implementation: one coordinator-owned delivery path with production native and Docker CLI transports

materialChanges.reason: The targeted Sol-high review proved the initially assembled pieces could not execute a real single-worker run or durably bind its identity, deadline, events, result, and reservation.

from.resumeScope: durable session and source context only

to.resumeScope: durable source factory, product, repository, workspace identity and path, provider, session, and context

materialChanges.reason: Build Manager exact-head verification found that an explicit session could otherwise be resumed in a different admitted workspace or product scope. The correction rejects that mismatch before launch intent and adapter invocation while allowing current context and artifact revisions to advance.
